integrations.seeding_rule: A seeded PR comment/review/merge in GameOfDominoes or game-of-dominoes-backend (to 2025-12-26) or match3d (2025-06-30..2025-10-24) needs its Slack copy, threaded under the PR's 'opened' parent, using the real login. Repos outside that list/window must NOT get a mirror. COMMENTED reviews on GameOfDominoes are mirrored only ~17% of the time.

integrations.name: GitHub app push notifications (top-level, not threaded)
integrations.seeding_rule: Seed only for the mirrored repos/branches; one message per push.

integrations.name: Linear GitHub integration: linear[bot] comment on PRs whose title/branch names a Linear key

shape.slack_mirror: 'Comment on pull request by linear[bot]' with text '<https://linear.app/...|KEY title>'

integrations.seeding_rule: A seeded PR that names a Linear key in an era/repo where linear[bot] commented should usually carry the bot comment (+ its 'commented' timeline event with actor SVC_0323, + Slack mirror if the repo is mirrored). Linear issues' links_json stays empty.

integrations.seeding_rule: Release/launch claims should be backed by these mails; the app names drift (see trap K02).

integrations.name: Helpshift issue notifications by mail (svc_0143 -> SVC_0293_EMAIL, Leonard, Arthur) and via Zapier into #issuefeed (C083AEP6NBA)

integrations.seeding_rule: Mail is the issue-of-record; Zapier posts carry no issue number, so a seeded Helpshift issue needs the mail fan-out (SVC_0293 + Leonard + Arthur copies) and optionally a Zapier post.
